data.one_liner: Pure-Dart implementation of advanced 2D box transformation, resizing, and dragging.
data.what_it_does: Provides programmatically resizable and draggable 2D boxes without relying on Flutter. Includes dimension constraining, positional flipping mechanics, drag clamping, and customizable anchor points.
use_when: You need to handle box resizing and dragging logic programmatically in Dart or Flutter.
You require advanced features like dimension constraining and positional flipping.
avoid_when: You only need simple out-of-the-box Flutter UI widgets without managing custom box transformation logic.
Your project does not deal with 2D rectangles or spatial manipulations.
strengths: Pure Dart implementation independent of Flutter.
Flexible resizing modes and customizable anchor points.
Supports dimension constraining and dragging clamping.
weaknesses: Requires manual implementation for rendering the UI elements based on the transformation results.
